source.name: Mahala Palm Springs official hotel website
source.rightsEvidence: The requester attested that internal full-page desktop/mobile capture and derived design-prompt retention are cleared, and later explicitly confirmed that these screenshots may be sent to the LaunchLoom pipeline model as visual references. No hotel-owner grant or written license was uploaded. See the requester-attestation and provenance files.

capture.method: Rendered the official website directly in an isolated agent-browser Chromium session; full-page screenshots were captured from the live source page, not from a gallery or third-party screenshot.
capture.diagnostics: The document width matched both viewports with no horizontal overflow. The looping hero video had a ready 1920 by 1080 frame. Eighteen of 39 image elements loaded; the remaining elements were CSS-hidden, zero-rectangle carousel/gallery content, with no image requests reporting failure. The screenshots preserve the current visible gallery state only. Original photo/video/logo files are not separately included in this dossier.

provenance.attribution: Official source page: Mahala Palm Springs, https://mahalahotel.com/. Full-page captures retained under the requester-attested internal scope recorded in rights/REQUESTER-ATTESTATION.md.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The official boutique-hotel site uses a playful retro-desert visual identity rather than a conventional hospitality template. A tiny orange sun mark and wordmark sit above a short, looped botanical video hero with a central welcome statement. A deep teal patterned field holds a bright illustrated property card beside a compact narrative. The next section is an unusually dense photographic atlas on saturated golden yellow. A darker room photograph becomes a cinematic pause, followed by a lush foliage-backed room-offerings chapter with pale yellow cards. A dark contact form and a separate, highly graphic merchandise shelf close the full page. The system blends real interior/exterior photography with bold flat illustration, pattern, and strong color blocks. The specific logo, video, property art, room names, amenities, copy, prices, products, and booking claims belong to the source and must not be copied. The capture measures 1536 by 12524 desktop and 390 by 20772 portrait mobile; no horizontal overflow was measured.

heroGeometry.mode: compact wordmark over a botanical video/picture field with centered welcome copy
heroGeometry.alignment: centered opening set within a full-width atmospheric image
heroGeometry.viewport: brand, concise hospitality promise, and booking route remain the first visual moment

navigationGeometry.mode: small wordmark plus short utility links and a single direct booking control
navigationGeometry.placement: shallow top bar above the video or hero field
navigationGeometry.mobile: compressed brand and accessible menu/action; keep booking reachable without a large overlay

typography.display: rounded, friendly display sans or expressive wordmark treatment paired with compact neutral sans
typography.body: clean sans with high readability against saturated patterned surfaces
typography.scale: short central hero message, compact top navigation, clear room names, and readable amenity bullets

palette.ink: deep green-black with white hero text
palette.contrastIntent: bold color blocking with readable foregrounds; avoid light text on busy patterns without a solid backing

imageTreatment.mode: muted looping botanical hero, illustrated place vignette, dense photo atlas, cinematic room still, and close-up interiors
imageTreatment.crop: a mix of compact portrait tiles, landscape room stills, and full-bleed cinematic scenes
imageTreatment.focalPoint: maintain a clear subject inside each mosaic cell; use client-owned venue and room imagery, not source-site photography

servicePresentation.pattern: room or hospitality offerings appear as a small grid of editorial cards with real photos, clear names, concise amenity facts, and a direct detail/booking action
servicePresentation.interaction: the photo atlas can link to room, experience, or gallery details; cards retain visible links and useful text without hover
servicePresentation.adaptation: use room cards only for actual lodging inventory; for a restaurant or local service, replace the section with a verified offering directory and remove the source merchandise section unless the client has a real shop

ctaPlacement.primary: direct booking route in the top navigation and repeated beside actual room or service decisions
ctaPlacement.secondary: gallery, place story, contact, or shop when commerce exists
ctaPlacement.early: make one real booking or inquiry action immediately findable without allowing the colorful identity to obscure it

motion.primitive: muted looping hero video paired with a still image and editorial scrolling chapters
motion.library: CSS/native browser behavior; no heavy animation framework required
motion.reducedMotion: replace video with a still poster, avoid parallax, and preserve the same booking and image content

mobileRecomposition.strategy: long portrait sequence with the illustrated story, mosaic, cinematic room, room offerings, contact, and optional shop stacked in order
rules: keep the small brand and booking action readable at the top
stack illustration and narrative rather than shrinking them side by side
make the photo atlas scroll vertically with distinct tile sizing and no forced horizontal page movement
stack room/service cards with adequate text and touch target sizes
replace the hero video with a still on data saver or reduced motion and keep text legible

prohibitedPatterns: copying Mahala's name, orange circular brand mark, wordmark, illustration, video, photos, room names, amenities, products, text, prices, location, or booking promise
inventing rooms, amenities, capacity, rates, pet rules, accessibility, availability, or resort facilities
using source property imagery as a client's actual location or using stock imagery to imply client-owned rooms
using an autoplay video without a still poster, reduced-motion behavior, and an accessible booking route
copying the source merchandise shop for a client without a real catalog and checkout integration
placing text directly over dense patterns without contrast or reducing room details to unreadable microcopy

requiredSignatureElements.description: expressive atmospheric hero with static poster fallback and direct action
custom illustration or graphic vignette paired with concise place narrative
dense but intentionally paced client-property image composition
small set of verified rooms, services, or offerings with direct actions

acceptanceChecks: desktop preserves the bold retro-hospitality color and image rhythm without copying the source identity
mobile is a readable portrait stack with no horizontal overflow or booking-control obstruction
video has poster and reduced-motion/data-saving fallbacks and is never required to understand the offer
room names, amenities, prices, availability, contact details, and booking behavior bind only to verified content
source photographs, videos, logo, illustration, and merchandise assets are not copied into deployed client output

review.scope: Official page rendered and captured at desktop and portrait-mobile widths; full-page screenshots and derived prompt are retained under requester attestation, including model-reference use. No owner grant file was uploaded.
